messages.subject: Is it possible to perform pixel binning?
messages.subject_clean: Is it possible to perform pixel binning?
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I would like to know if there is an easy way to perform pixel binning using Cardinal?

For instance, I want to combine an MSI data from four neighboring pixels (2x2 binning) into a single "super-pixel" (The ion intensity for each mass feature will be summed).  See figure below.

Thanks a lot,

Dong

messages.subject: Re: image(ssc) returns no image
messages.body_plain:
SSC currently has a known issue when a dataset contains a degenerate (constant) z-dimension (usually added by Bruker tools). That is (probably) the culprit.

Remove the unnecessary z-coordindate with coord(mydata_cont)$z <- NULL and try again. I would also recommend peak-picking or binning before segmenting.

-Kylie
